column3: MT 58:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew; “in silence” is rendered as an address, “you silent ones,” and “sons of men” is taken as vocative.
Close to the Hebrew; זֹרוּ (“are estranged”) is rendered “are estranged.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the teeth of young lions” is rendered “the fangs of the young lions.”
The second half is difficult; NKJV renders “When he bends his bow, Let his arrows be as if cut in pieces.”
The verse is very obscure; NKJV renders “He shall take them away as with a whirlwind, As in His living and burning wrath.”
Close to the Hebrew; פְּרִי (“fruit”) is rendered “a reward,” and “a God who judges” “He is God who judges.”
